english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something turns into a different state, type, or identity.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when something ends up in another form, state, or use, including a deliberate change of purpose.
This is the all-purpose choice for something changing into a new form or state, including an agent turning A into B.
Use this when emphasizing what the thing becomes, especially in patterns like 將 A 變成 B.
Use this when something changes into a new condition, form, colour, or state.

examples.english: After graduating, they become a very experienced chef.
examples.traditional: 畢業之後，佢變成一個好有經驗嘅廚師。
